test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held On: 28 June, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT an example of a minor industrial region of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hugli region**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Hugli region** is **NOT **an example of a** minor industrial region of India.**
 
• The Hooghly region encompasses a sprawling industrial zone spanning **2,000 square kilometers** along the** banks of the Hooghly River **in India, stretching from** Bansberia in the north to Birlanagar in the south.**
 
• It constitutes India's oldest and second-largest industrial area, known as the Hooghly Industrial Belt.
 
• Situated in West Bengal, approximately 40 kilometers north of Kolkata, the Hooghly district derives its name from the Hooghly River, which flows along its western bank.
 
• Renowned for its economic prosperity, the district serves as a prominent center for jute cultivation, jute industry, and jute trade within the state.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **The Ambala-Amritsar industrial region,** situated in the states of Haryana and Punjab, is a minor industrial area in India.
 
• **The North Malabar region** in Kerala, India, is also recognized as a minor industrial zone.
 
• **Minor Industrial Regions in India** are:
 
 
• Ambala-Amritsar in Haryana-Punjab.
 
• Saharanpur-Muzaffarnagar-Bijnor in Uttar Pradesh.
 
• Indore-Dewas-Ujjain in Madhya Pradesh.
 
• Jaipur-Ajmer in Rajasthan.
 
• Kolhapur-South Kannada in Maharashtra-Karnataka.
 
• Northern Malabar in Kerala.
 
• Middle Malabar in Kerala.
 
• Adilabad-Nizamabad in Andhra Pradesh.
 
• Allahabad-Varanasi-Mirzapur in Uttar Pradesh.
 
• Bhojpur-Munger in Bihar.
